  $S \to aAS$
  $S \to bBS$

  $Ab \to bA$
  $Ba \to aB$
  $Bb \to bB$
  $AS \to Sa$
  $BS \to Sb$
  $S \to \varepsilon$

Give a derivation of `abbabb`!
